data.name: Jyotsna
data.gender_notes: Jyotsna is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit jyotsnā, 'moonlight', from the root jyut, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit jyotsnā (ज्योत्स्ना). A classical Sanskrit term for moonlight. Jyotsna is a Sanskrit name meaning “Moonlight; a moonlit night”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jyotsna expresses “Moonlight; a moonlit night”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit jyotsnā, 'moonlight', from the root jyut, 'to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jyotsna total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
